description: MUST-FAIL: float 0.0 in a digest-bearing field. Parsed form of JSON tokens '0.0' and '0e0'. Same cross-implementation split: Python rejects (FloatInDigestError); Node JCS accepts (integer 0, serializes as '0'). Note: JSON token '-0' parses to integer 0 in Python (not float), so -0 is NOT covered by this vector — it is ACCEPTED by the value-rule implementation (see separate informative note). This vector covers the '0.0' and '0e0' token forms specifically. Mutation probe: same as kat-24/25.
cross_impl_note: Python json.loads('0.0') -> float(0.0), which hits FloatInDigestError. Python json.loads('-0') -> int(0), which is ACCEPTED. Node JCS accepts '0.0' (integer 0) and also accepts '-0' (integer -0, which Number.isInteger(-0) = true). The -0 token gap (both Python and Node accept, value-rule cannot distinguish from 0) is a separate informative note.
mutation_probe: Replace `isinstance(v, float)` with `isinstance(v, float) and v != int(v)` — passes (0.0 == 0). The test must go red with that mutant.
